text: Welcome to the consultation. I understand you have been experiencing a headache and worsening vision over the past three weeks. To better assist you, could you describe the specific nature of your headache and any visual changes you have noticed?

text: 69-year-old woman. The patient reports a 3-week history of headache and progressively worsening vision. She has not noticed any other symptoms, including no recent weight changes, no fevers, no night sweats, and no pain elsewhere in the body.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. To narrow the differential between a space-occupying lesion, giant cell arteritis, or metastatic disease, could you describe the exact location of your headache and whether it is worse in the morning or with exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Headache. I also have Worsening vision over the past 3 weeks, No weight changes, No fevers, No night sweats, No other pain.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Brain Tumor (Glioblastoma) or Metastatic Brain Tumor.
